info.name: Hermes Agent - SA Advanced Testing Scenarios (jopCoba)
info.description: Postman Collection baru untuk pengujian End-to-End EKSAD System Analyst Agent (Port 8643) di folder jopCoba. Berisi skenario lengkap 5-Step Lifecycle: Health Check, Create Session dengan 8 variabel user_context, Generate Dokumen TSD, Verify & Download History Descending (Terbaru di paling atas), dan Delete Session.

item.name: Step 2 - Generate Dokumen TSD Svc Procurement Approval

body.raw:
{
  "message": "[USER_CONTEXT]\n{\n  \"user_id\": \"{{user_id}}\",\n  \"username\": \"jovan_sa_test\",\n  \"role\": \"System Analyst\",\n  \"department\": \"IT Architecture Team\",\n  \"project_id\": \"{{project_id}}\",\n  \"project_name\": \"{{project_name}}\",\n  \"tenant_id\": \"{{tenant_id}}\",\n  \"tenant_name\": \"{{tenant_name}}\"\n}\n\nHalo Hermes System Analyst Agent! Tolong sebutkan seluruh detail user_context saya (user_id, username, role, department, project_id, project_name, tenant_id, tenant_name) yang kamu terima, lalu buatkan dokumen TSD (Technical Specification Document) lengkap untuk microservice Svc Procurement Approval (meliputi: Skema Flyway DDL 7 Audit Columns, API Contract REST @RolesAllowed, RabbitMQ Event Envelope Schema, & STRIDE Threat Modeling).",
  "user_id": "{{user_id}}",
  "user_context": {
    "user_id": "{{user_id}}",
    "username": "jovan_sa_test",
    "role": "System Analyst",
    "department": "IT Architecture Team",
    "project_id": "{{project_id}}",
    "project_name": "{{project_name}}",
    "tenant_id": "{{tenant_id}}",
    "tenant_name": "{{tenant_name}}"
  }
}

request.description: Mengirimkan prompt pembentukan Dokumen TSD lengkap. Hermes Agent membaca seluruh 8 variabel user_context dan meng-generate isi dokumen TSD utuh pada atribut 'content'.
